reason: The J3 component as declared cannot carry the declared stroke. The row's mechanism says J3 is 'the arm-fixed shoe on the open wire-race band (caged balls; cage excluded as a rolling element, needs anti-creep)'. In a non-recirculating caged-ball guide the cage moves half the stroke relative to the shoe. So the shoe must be at least as long as the cage plus T/2: T/2 = 48.97 deg, but the shoe arc is Ls = 39.46 deg. The cage leaves the shoe for ANY cage length: 144 mm of stroke on the 84 mm track radius against a 58 mm shoe. A shoe long enough (>= 49 deg + cage) adds the same arc to the band (band arc = T + Ls + stops, now 141 deg), which pushes it toward the ~150-180 deg torso-free sector the row names as the limiter. A plain iglidur-lined shoe would fit the modelled 2 + 6 + 2 envelope (the simplicity count already prices the track as a sliding pair, 2.75 unchanged), so the number may stand. But the component list (ball set, cage, 4 race wires) names a part that does not work at this stroke.
